verdict.rationale: Thoropass explicitly supports creating custom Unified Controls not offered out-of-the-box (thoropass-docs-56), and lets users view framework-specific controls alongside Unified Controls (thoropass-docs-58, thoropass-docs-37). However, there is no evidence of adding an entirely custom framework, nor of defining custom tests or bespoke evidence requirements tied to a custom control. missing for 10: ability to define a wholly new custom framework, custom test logic per control, and custom evidence requirement definitions.
